cells.gaps: No source gives the share of the population or of adults holding a NIN: 121 million numbers were issued by September 2026, against NIMC's target of 180 million.
cells.note: Restaged 2026-11-09 on Bill's ruling (message 108): NIMC's ISO 27001 certification stands, but stage 5 now also needs the ID held by all or nearly all the population, and 121 million NINs issued by September 2026 with a target of 180 million does not show it. Numbers are issued after biometric de-duplication.
